title: Cables and calibration targets
cables_note: VRH9, VR and VRD share one power and I/O cable and one Gigabit Ethernet cable; pin assignment in the data sheet. Power supply 24 V DC, rated 75 W or more; the PRS draws up to 4 A. The TRS series outputs over CoaXPress and requires a CoaXPress frame grabber in the host computer; recommended grabber on request. Power and I/O cable for the TRS series and cables for the PRS: on request.
targets_lede: Each camera model is calibrated on a target matched to its field of view: an array of square markers on a flat substrate. Marker pitch is the distance between marker centers, marker size the side of each square, pattern tolerance the position tolerance of the marker corners. Targets for the VRH9-020B, the TRS series and the PRS on request.
cta_title: Targets and cables: order them with the camera.
cta_desc: Tell us the model and the cable lengths; you receive one quotation for camera, cables, target and software.
